# `tools/inspector/panels/InspectorStyles.js`

> **Source:** `engine/tools/inspector/panels/InspectorStyles.js`

InspectorStyles.js - Shared styles for standalone inspector panels Call injectInspectorStyles() before mounting any standalone panel to ensure consistent styling (scrollbars, inputs, etc.)

## Functions

### `injectInspectorStyles(doc = document)`

Inject shared inspector styles into the document. Safe to call multiple times - will only inject once.

**Parameters:**

- `doc` *(Document)* — Document to inject styles into (default: document)

### `applyPanelContainerStyles(container)`

Apply standard inspector panel container styles to a DOM element.

**Parameters:**

- `container` *(HTMLElement)* — Element to style

### `areStylesInjected()`

Check if inspector styles have been injected
